kimi-k3.note: Kimi Platform pay-as-you-go proxy; Kimi Code itself uses membership billing. Cache creation is charged at cache-miss input rate.

claude-opus-4-8.note: Standard global API with the default five-minute cache-write TTL.

qwen3.8-max-preview.note: Alibaba Cloud Token Plan is a fixed-fee subscription. Credits vary dynamically with model, token usage, thinking mode, and tool calls; the official documentation says actual Credits are available only in the console usage details. No auditable per-token tariff is available, so per-run monetary cost is deliberately left unattributed.

disclaimer: Kimi K3 and Claude costs are offline per-token estimates. Qwen3.8 Token Plan rows retain exact token volume but no fabricated monetary cost because the subscription's dynamic Credits are not present in the experiment artifacts.
